evaluation.a: Rush: one step, pass in as little as {rushDays} day, no consistency rule. Flex: one step, at least {flexDays} days, and your best day can't exceed {flexConsistency}% of total profit. Instant: no evaluation, you're funded right away. No time limit.

drawdown.q: What is an EOD trailing drawdown?
drawdown.a: Your liquidation level follows your highest end-of-day balance, not your intraday peaks. It stops moving once it reaches your starting balance + {lock}.

payouts.q: When can I request a payout?
payouts.a: Every {winning} winning days (sessions closed at {winningMin} or more), with a {minPayout} minimum. Each payout is capped from {capMin} (25K) to {capMax} (150K). The counter resets after each payout.

split.q: What profit split do I get?
split.a: You keep {split}% of your profits. Higher Pass ranks unlock a better split.

real.a: No. All accounts are simulated trading accounts. Aurum Funded is not a broker and does not accept customer deposits.

payLater.a: With Pay Later (Rush and Flex), you pay a reduced price today and an activation fee only if you pass. You have {deadline} days to pay it. Not combinable with promo codes.

instant.q: How many Instant accounts can I have?
instant.a: Up to {maxInstant} active Instant accounts at a time. A lost Instant account can't be reset: you need to buy a new one.
